subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Lianna and the Hombit
email_body:
Hi Valinora,

I came across Lianna and the Hombit and was taken by the premise of a grieving thirteen year old who strikes a bargain with a magical birdlike hombit in the land of Nivram. It is also a lovely way to return to the world of your Lucky Diamond trilogy as a prequel. A story about friendship and healing set in such an imaginative world feels like a great fit for our readers.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Lianna and the Hombit is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional and separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Lianna and the Hombit best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
